evaluation_method: Manual semantic review of complete response against scenario assertions; runtime/artifact checks also verified. Not a keyword grader or live dispatch test.

expectations.text: The worker retains scoped evidence and promptly notifies the document owner rather than waiting for the final session pass or rewriting another owner's document.
expectations.evidence: Contradiction: says notify promptly but permits "(or awaits the explicit serial dependency)". This weakens immediate owner notification while unrelated tasks run. See response.md and transcript.md.
